title: Article 305 — Saving of existing laws and laws providing for State monopolies

content.overview: Article 305 provides that nothing in Articles 301 and 303 shall affect the provisions of any existing law except in so far as the President may by order otherwise direct, and nothing in Article 301 shall affect the operation of any law made before the commencement of the Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956, in so far as it relates to, or prevent Parliament or the State Legislature from making any law relating to, any such matter as is referred to in Article 19(6)(ii) (State monopoly for any trade, business, industry or service).
content.glance: Existing laws saved from Arts 301/303 unless President otherwise directs. State monopoly laws (Art 19(6)(ii) type) saved from Art 301; Parliament/States may still make such monopoly laws.
content.study:
Article 305 savings:
1. Existing laws: not affected by Arts 301 and 303 except as the President by order otherwise directs.
2. State monopoly: Art 301 does not affect operation of pre-7th Amendment laws relating to State monopolies of the kind in Art 19(6)(ii), and does not prevent Parliament or States from making such monopoly laws.

Examination: existing-law saving; Presidential order exception; State monopoly saving linked to Art 19(6)(ii).

sections.heading: Savings
sections.body:
1. Existing laws unaffected by Arts 301 and 303 unless President by order otherwise directs.
2. Art 301 does not bar State-monopoly type laws (Art 19(6)(ii)); such laws may continue and may be enacted.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What does Article 305 save?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Article 305 provides that nothing in Articles 301 and 303 shall affect the provisions of any existing law except insofar as the President may by order otherwise direct. It also provides that nothing in Article 301 shall affect the operation of any law made before the Seventh Amendment relating to State monopolies of the kind referred to in Article 19(6)(ii), or prevent Parliament or a State Legislature from making any law relating to such a monopoly.

examTips: Existing laws saved; State monopoly laws saved from Art 301.

keyTakeaways: Art 305: saving of existing laws and State monopoly laws.
